subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add outbound Telegram album/media-group support to the bundled Telegram plugin now, and should the open draft implementation be ported or superseded?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing Telegram action/behavior surface and touches multiple delivery funnels, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Port the draft into current Telegram funnels
options.body: Use the linked draft PR as implementation input, but adapt it to current durable send, reply delivery, outbound adapter, docs, and live-proof requirements.

options.title: Keep sequential fan-out only
options.body: Treat album grouping as not planned for now and close or explicitly supersede the linked draft after documenting the supported `mediaUrls` behavior.

options.title: Narrow to one surface first
options.body: Approve album support only for one entry point, such as reply delivery or `message.send`, and leave the remaining surfaces tracked separately.

recommendation.title: Port the draft into current Telegram funnels
recommendation.body: Use the linked draft PR as implementation input, but adapt it to current durable send, reply delivery, outbound adapter, docs, and live-proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already performed maintainer cleanup on this issue and has recent Telegram action-runtime ownership signals.
